name: Veyora
storyline:
In Veyora, there is no set path. You decide what to make of your life – focus on peaceful farming, prepare for battles against dark creatures, or combine both. Build freely whatever you wish: a simple home, a sprawling farm, or a fortified base. Cultivate crops, raise animals, gather resources, and craft everything you need to survive.

Darkness and Discovery

Beneath the world’s peaceful surface lie hidden dangers. Bandits and mystical creatures roam the forests, while deep dungeons conceal treasures, puzzles, and ancient secrets. Those who dare to face the darkness will find both risk and reward.
Together or Alone

Explore Veyora on your own or together with up to four friends in cooperative mode. With loyal NPC companions by your side or as part of a group, you can explore the world, build together, trade, fight, and survive.
summary: Veyora is a medieval open-world RPG with elements of farming, survival, and adventure. In a vast, stylized world, you decide where to live and what to create – whether near a bustling town, in the lonely mountains, or by a peaceful lake. Each location offers its own resources, challenges, and opportunities.
